title: add vpc control plane networking: subnets, endpoints, security-groups, peering, dns
author: Ava Martinez
body: Summary: Add a reusable Terraform module and associated Helm/upgrade hooks to provision VPC networking required for the Private Control Plane. This includes multi-AZ subnets, route tables, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account/cross-region peering, and Route53 private zone automation. Motivation: customers deploying the Private control plane frequently ask for a repeatable, supported Terraform path that sets up networking requirements (private subnets, interface endpoints for SSM/ECR/KMS, security groups, and DNS peering) and the installer needs to coordinate DNS and peering during upgrades and rollbacks. What changed: - New Terraform module: modules/vpc-control-plane (main entrypoint and examples) - Creates: VPC, public/private subnets (multi-az), NATs, route tables, NACLs (minimal defaults), interface endpoints for: com.amazonaws.* (ssm, ec2, ecr, logs, kms), ECR API/DOCKER endpoints when requested - Security groups: control-plane-sg (tight inbound rules for LB, control plane nodes), cross-account peering SG rules - VPC Peering / Transit support: optional peering resources and automated route table updates when enabled. Supports both single-account and cross-account with explicit peer role ARNs. - Route53 automation: private hosted zone creation and zone association with peer VPCs; optional Route53 resolver rules for cross-account name resolution. - Helm: values.yaml additions to accept vpc/network metadata (subnet ids, peering ids, dns zone ids), chart hooks for upgrade pre-checks and post-upgrade DNS association reconciles. - Upgrade/rollback tooling: a short-lived job (k8s Job) that runs during installer upgrades to reconcile route53 associations and peering routes; supports automatic rollback path using saved tfstate snapshot. - Examples: examples/aws/staging.tf and examples/aws/production.tf showing commons patterns (single-account, cross-account, multi-region peering). Backwards compatibility: defaults keep previous behavior when vpc module is not enabled. Migration: README includes instructions to migrate an existing control plane by running the module in plan-only first and then a staged apply with the helm chart values set to reference the newly created subnets/endpoints. Testing performed: - Unit: terraform validate + tflint in CI - Integration: applied module in staging (us-west-2) + helm install of private-installer; smoke tests confirming control-plane API reachability and token issuance across peered VPCs - E2E: full install with Route53 private zone associations and resolver rules validated from an application VPC via dig and curl - Canary: deployed to perf-canary for 48h to observe DNS resolution and latency under load Rollback plan: - Helm: use helm rollback for chart releases - Terraform: if apply fails or post-upgrade issues are discovered, run terraform apply against saved previous state snapshot (we store snapshots in S3 with an apply timestamp) and revert Route53 associations manually using the provided tooling script scripts/reconcile-dns.sh Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented + examples - [x] Helm chart values + hooks added - [x] Integration tests + canary run - [x] Docs: README + migration steps added - [x] Security review for SG rules and endpoint policies Notes/constraints: - By default the module does NOT create public internet-facing resources other than the NATs needed for private subnets. - Cross-account peering requires an explicit peer role ARN to be configured; automated acceptance for peer accounts is gated behind a separate support flow (SUP-2123). - This PR does not enable Transit Gateway by default; TGW support is planned as a follow-up. Release notes: Adds a supported Terraform module and installer hooks to provision VPC networking for Private control plane deployments. See README for migration steps and examples.
commits: feat(terraform): add modules/vpc-control-plane with multi-az subnet and endpoint resources
feat(helm): expose vpc metadata in values.yaml and add pre/post upgrade hooks
chore(ci): add terraform validate and tflint to pipeline for vpc module
docs: add migration guide and examples for single-account and cross-account setups
fix: tighten security group rules and endpoint policy after review
review_comments: Ravi Patel: overall looks good. nits: tighten SG egress to only required services and add module-level var to opt into resolver rules. also please add a note about potential downtime during route table updates.
Ava Martinez: responded - added sg_egress_restrictions var, added docs note about applying during low-traffic windows, added reconcile job to minimize disruption.
Marta Nguyen: approve after CI fixes. please bump module version and add changelog entry.
Jordan Lee: verified DNS associations in staging, LGTM. noted one minor terraform lint warning which was fixed in last commit.
release_notes: Adds a supported Terraform module (modules/vpc-control-plane) and installer Helm hooks to provision subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, VPC peering, and Route53 private DNS associations for Private control plane deployments. Includes examples and migration docs.
